{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
# Only if there are commas to remove
if df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).sum() > 0:
    df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
else:
    df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Check if any QA orders are in the `loyal` segment
qa_loyal = qa_orders[qa_orders['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']
print(f"Number of QA orders in the loyal segment: {len(qa_loyal)}")

# Show the QA orders in the loyal segment
print("\nQA orders in the loyal segment:")
print(qa_loyal[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue', 'converted']])"}
